```{ojs}
{
  const input = tf.tensor([drawing_pad], [1, 784]);
  const prediction = model.predict(input);
  const predictedProbabilities = await prediction.data();
  const probs =  d3.sort(Array.from(predictedProbabilities)
    .map((p,digit) => ({p,digit})), o => -o.p);
  const display = d3.create('div')
  display.append('div')
    .text("CNN Says")
    .style('font-weight', 'bold')
  if(probs[0].p > 0.99) {
    if(probs[0].digit == 8) {
      display.append('div')
        .text("That's an 8!")
    }
    else {
      display.append('div')
        .text(`That's a ${probs[0].digit}!`)
    }
    return display.node();
  }
  else {
    const results = probs.filter(o => o.p > 0.01);
    display.append('div')
      .text("Test inconclusive; probabilities are:");
    const table = display.append('table')
    const digit_row = table.append('tr');
    digit_row.append('th')
      .text('d')
      .style('background-color', '#aaa')
      .style('border', 'solid 1px currentcolor')
      .style('padding', '1px 5px 1px 5px');
    const prob_row = table.append('tr')
    prob_row.append('th')
      .text('p')
      .style('background-color', '#aaa')
      .style('border', 'solid 1px currentcolor')
      .style('padding', '1px 5px 1px 5px');
    results.forEach(function(o) {
      digit_row.append('td')
        .text(o.digit)
        .style('border', 'solid 1px currentcolor')
        .style('text-align', 'center')
      prob_row.append('td')
        .text(d3.format('0.3f')(o.p))
        .style('border', 'solid 1px currentcolor')
        .style('padding', '1px 3px 1px 3px');
    })
  }

  display.append('div')
    .text("KNN Loading")
    .style('font-weight', 'bold')
    .style('opacity', 0.5) 

  return display.node();
}
```

```{ojs}
model = await tf.loadLayersModel('./components/cnn-model.json');
classifier = {
  const classifier = knnClassifier.create();
  for (let i = 0; i < mnistData.X.length; i++) {
    const inputTensor = tf.tensor(mnistData.X[i], [784]);
    const label = mnistData.y[i];
    classifier.addExample(inputTensor, label);
    inputTensor.dispose();
    if(i%10 == 0 ) {
      await Promises.delay(0);
    }
  }
 return classifier;
};
mnistData = await (
  await (
    await FileAttachment("./components/mnist_train_data.json.zip").zip()
  ).file("mnist_train_data.json")
).json();
```
